import time,random
em="woybangsatkauuu@gmail.com"; un=f"kglur{random.randint(100000,999999)}"

    b=p.chromium.launch(headless=False,args=["--no-sandbox","--disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled"])
    ctx=b.new_context(viewport={"width":1366,"height":900},locale="en-US",

    pg.fill('input[name="password"]',"Kaggle!2026xyz")
